## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Which area of the theme does this affect?

- [ ] Homepage / blog listing
- [ ] Article page (reading, TOC, related posts, sharing)
- [ ] Categories / tags / author pages
- [ ] SEO (metadata, sitemap, RSS, structured data)
- [ ] Images / media (local, R2 / S3)
- [ ] Search
- [ ] Configuration / theming (colors, fonts, navigation, footer)
- [ ] Content model / collections
- [ ] Performance / accessibility
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Workflows / CI
- [ ] Other: ___

## Additional context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
Please keep the theme generic: Astroplate powers many independent sites,
so a feature must work without hardcoding one site's branding or content.
